shipments_export_consistency.name: shipments_export_consistency
shipments_export_consistency.value:
(("shipments"."status" = 'EXPORTED')
        = (("shipments"."exported_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("shipments"."exported_by" IS NOT NULL)))

documents_superseded_consistency.name: documents_superseded_consistency
documents_superseded_consistency.value:
(( "documents"."is_active" = true  AND "documents"."superseded_at" IS NULL)
        OR ( "documents"."is_active" = false AND "documents"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL))

discrepancies_evidence_consistency.name: discrepancies_evidence_consistency
discrepancies_evidence_consistency.value:
( ("discrepancies"."expected_value" IS NULL AND "discrepancies"."actual_value" IS NULL AND "discrepancies"."delta_value" IS NULL)
        OR ("discrepancies"."expected_value" IS NOT NULL AND "discrepancies"."actual_value" IS NOT NULL
                                     AND "discrepancies"."delta_value" IS NOT NULL))

discrepancies_resolution_consistency.name: discrepancies_resolution_consistency
discrepancies_resolution_consistency.value:
(("discrepancies"."status" IN ('RESOLVED', 'WAIVED'))
        = ("discrepancies"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "discrepancies"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL))

approvals_decision_consistency.name: approvals_decision_consistency
approvals_decision_consistency.value:
( ("approvals"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "approvals"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "approvals"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("approvals"."status" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
              AND "approvals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "approvals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("approvals"."status" = 'INVALIDATED'))
